HALLUCINATIONS: None

All key financial terms in the memo are supported by the source document:

- Date of Agreement (March 25, 2021) - confirmed
- Borrower name (Crestwood Midstream Partners LP, Delaware limited partnership) - confirmed
- Administrative Agent (Wells Fargo Bank, National Association) - confirmed
- Original credit agreement date (October 16, 2018) - confirmed
- Maximum dividend/distribution amount ($275.0 million) - confirmed in Section 6.06(j)
- Change in Control threshold (35% aggregate ordinary voting power) - confirmed in amended definition
- Amendment effectiveness deadline (April 9, 2021) - confirmed in Section 2
- Lender fee (0.05% of revolving facility commitments) - confirmed in Section 2(b)
- 100% ownership requirement for Crestwood Equity Partners - confirmed in Change in Control definition

The memo accurately reflects the transaction structure, purpose, and key terms without adding unsupported financial information.

ANSWER: YES

MISSING_TERMS: 
• Original Credit Agreement date (October 16, 2018) - mentioned in memo context but not in key terms table
• Amendment effectiveness conditions including Required Lenders execution requirement
• Lender consent fee of 0.05% of Revolving Facility Commitment for early consent by March 25, 2021, 5:00 p.m.
• Administrative Agent name (Wells Fargo Bank, National Association) not in key terms table
• Third Amendment Effective Date deadline of April 9, 2021 mentioned in risks but not clearly stated as key term
• Unit Purchase consummation requirement as condition precedent to effectiveness
